situation (example wording): "Rate of robberies with a firearm in Georgia in 2024" (a rate of a detail only NIBRS records)
what the app does today: Divides by the population of the agencies that reported (weighted by months reported), not the whole state.
proposed behavior: Keep today's rule, and say it in the answer's own sentence: a state or national rate ends "..., per 100,000 in 2024, summed over the agencies that reported."; a Historical county sum says "The rate is per 100,000 of the reporting agencies' summed population."; a Homicide Reports rate says "Rate per 100,000 people in the agencies that reported." (P115).
exact default or choices offered: Denominator: population of the agencies counted.
why: Dividing partial counts by the whole state understates the rate.
test cases: correctness case: Houston murder victims by race and sex; new cases to write
